remarks: Located in Sylmar, 15230 Roxford St, Unit 57 is a two-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath townhouse-style condo offering 1,311 square feet of living space, priced at $475,000. The main level features an open floor plan with hardwood floors and recessed lighting, creating an inviting space for everyday living and entertaining. The living and dining areas flow into the kitchen, which features tile flooring and opens to a covered patio. With space for outdoor seating, plants, or a dining setup, the patio is a comfortable spot for morning coffee or winding down in the evening.
